proof_summary: Take \(n=18\): since \(\sigma(18)=39\), its reduced denominator is \(18/\gcd(18,39)=6\), while \(\sigma(6)=12\) makes the corresponding denominator at \(6\) equal to \(1=2^0\). Thus the premise holds at \(18\), but the conclusion would require \(6\) to be a power of two, which it is not.
